title: Sections and local equality after sheafification on a site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $\mathcal F$ be a presheaf of sets on $\mathcal C$, and let $\theta^2:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F^\#$ be its sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. For every object $U$ and section $s\in\mathcal F^\#(U)$, there is a covering $(U_i\to U)_{i\in I}$ and sections $s_i\in\mathcal F(U_i)$ such that $s|_{U_i}=\theta^2(s_i)$ and, for every $i,j$, the pullbacks of $s_i$ and $s_j$ agree after a further covering of $U_i\times_UU_j$. Conversely, any such compatible local sections glue uniquely to a section of $\mathcal F^\#(U)$. In particular, if $p,q\in\mathcal F(U)$ have equal images in $\mathcal F^\#(U)$, then there is a covering $(U_i\to U)_{i\in I}$ on which $p|_{U_i}=q|_{U_i}$. This is Sites, Theorem Tag 00WB (theorem-plus) and Lemma Tag 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification).

proof.text: Proved partial step: the universal sheafification unit is locally surjective, without a universe comparison. Let G be sheafify(F), eta its unit, and R the sheaf closure of the image subfunctor of eta inside G. Mathlib Subfunctor.sheafify_isSheaf makes R a sheaf. Factor F -> R through G using sheafifyLift. Composing the resulting lift with R -> G gives the identity by sheafify_hom_ext. Consequently every section of G belongs to R, so the image sieve of every section covers. This is the private Lean lemma unit_locally_surjective.

Proved partial step: for each section of sheafify(F), use Precoverage.mem_toGrothendieck_iff_of_isStableUnderComposition to extract a precoverage covering presieve inside its covering image sieve. Choose a preimage on each covering arrow. The resulting family represents the section locally. This is local_representatives; the locally-equal overlap assertion is not included.

Proved partial step: given locally compatible presheaf representatives, map them through the unit into the sheaf. Naturality carries each further-cover equality into equality after restriction in the sheaf. Separatedness on that cover proves compatibility on every overlap cone. The sheaf condition on the original covering then gives the unique amalgamation. This is the private Lean lemma local_descent.

STATEMENT-DISPUTED: the remaining local-injectivity assertion is false with the unrestricted independent universes u and w in the recorded Lean signature. For a sufficiently large complete atomless Boolean site, all Type w-valued sheaves are subterminal and their reflector exists as the sheaf closure of the support of a presheaf. The constant two-element presheaf reflects to the terminal sheaf, so its distinct sections have equal images and are nowhere locally equal on a nonzero object. The worker report gives the cardinality and support-reflector arguments. The previous double-plus dependencies only apply to Type (max u w), not to arbitrary Type w. No theorem of local injectivity in the unrestricted universes is added.
